ig_caption:
Your skill is fine. Your description isn't 🎯

Real test: a small model (qwen2.5 3B), 20 skills, one request: "Summarise what we shipped this sprint for our customers."
❌ description "Helps with docs." → the agent loads the WRONG skill (meeting-notes)
✅ "Writes release notes from merged pull requests. Use when asked for release notes, a changelog, or a sprint summary." → release-notes

The agent can only choose what the description promises. Don't trust it. Test it.

yt_description:
Why an AI agent skill never triggers: the agent selects skills from their descriptions. Real test with qwen2.5:3b and 20 skills: a vague description loaded the wrong skill; a specific one loaded the right one.
